task: T08 — is stage_clear reachable through the frozen evaluator's action channel (tools/rl/v410_student_eval.py)?

verdict.one_line: the evaluator's action channel is mechanically incapable of producing a SHOOT rising edge, so stage_clear cannot be reported; but no existing 0/N number is explained by it, because every evaluated episode ended in a death at <= 4964 frames, 8,000+ frames short of the clear
verdict.mechanism: cand_to_mask ORs BTN_SHOOT into every mask and the evaluator has no release path, so SHOOT is held on every frame of every episode; the engine needs a SHOOT|ENTER rising edge to leave a wait state, and neither the evaluator nor the harness provides one
verdict.impact_on_existing_zero_clear_counts: none measured: 1285 episode records, 1 clears, and the only record at or above 12,000 frames is the reward audit's own clear replay

q1_channel.question: which SHOOT state does the evaluator actually send?
q1_channel.answer: every frame carries BTN_SHOOT (0x0001); the bit is decided by touhou_rl/v400/gym/actions.py::cand_to_mask, which ORs it unconditionally; the default is 'shoot on'; there is no release path in either evaluator
q1_channel.wire: STEP <mask> <frames> on the harness stdin pipe; the mask is sent verbatim, the engine executes <frames> frames with it

citations.role: the only mask the decision becomes
the only STEP call in the loop
BTN_SHOOT is ORed unconditionally; `bomb` is the only tunable bit

citations.text: def cand_to_mask(cand: int, bomb: int = 0) -> int:
citations.role: there is no `shoot` argument to clear
the mask reaches the engine unmodified
the engine role/control the evaluator starts
the decoder refuses a mask without SHOOT at all: 'not representable as a candidate'

citations.text: - **智能体掩码的白名单**：`SHOOT|BOMB|FOCUS|UP|DOWN|LEFT|RIGHT`，即 `0x00F7`。MENU(0x8)、SKIP(0x100)、Q(0x200)、S(0x400)、HOME(0x800，Linux 上截图会污染下一帧)、ENTER(0x1000)、D(0x2000)、RESET(0x4000) 一律清掉。 | - **换面**：`GameManager.cpp:381-389` 需要 `g_CurFrameInput` 中出现 `SHOOT|ENTER` 的**上升沿**才会进入下一面；按住 SHOOT 不算上升沿。当处于等待换面的状态时，harness 每隔一帧注入一次 ENTER 脉冲。
citations.role: the agent mask whitelist (0x00F7) strips ENTER, and the transition needs a SHOOT|ENTER rising edge; the doc says the harness injects an ENTER pulse, the measurement below shows it does not happen

mask_enumeration.note: all 18 masks the evaluator can emit carry 0x0001; a release would have to come from code that does not exist

release_paths_searched.release_due_call_sites: grep -rn release_due --include=*.py touhou_rl tools -> 10 hits, all in teacher/collector/training code; none in either evaluator

harness_enter_pulse.documented: 10-P0 §4.2 line 237 (the harness injects an ENTER pulse every other frame while waiting for the stage transition)
harness_enter_pulse.observed: no ENTER bit ever appears on the wire: the masks are the 18 candidate masks (whitelist 0x00F7), and the evaluation holds for 15,564 frames
harness_enter_pulse.source_of_the_doubt: touhou_rl/v400/teacher/shoot.py docstring: rlharness.cpp has no 0x1000 path

q2_experiment.question: does the evaluator's channel clear the recorded Stage-1 tape, and does a SHOOT pulse clear it?

channel.decision_steps: consecutive -> (2, 1): two STEP commands of 1 frame

runs.shoot_release: release_due(i, 48) -> last frame of that decision drops SHOOT|BOMB

reproduces_the_documented_pair.note: the three pulse numbers match RL_AUDIT.md §4/§5.1 and reward_r3.json's clear class exactly; the no-pulse score plateau matches 141,379 but the frame at which the earlier ad-hoc measurement stopped (13,272) is a horizon choice, not a mechanism difference — this run continued to 15,564 frames and never cleared

q3_fix.status: proposed only — tools/** is read-only for this task
q3_fix.where: tools/rl/v410_student_eval.py::run_episode (the STEP loop at line 975) and tools/rl/v400_student_eval.py::run_episode (the same loop at line 511)
q3_fix.rule: import release_due from touhou_rl.v400.teacher.shoot and BTN_SHOOT|BTN_BOMB from touhou_rl.spec; at decision i, if release_due(i, 48) and the decision has more than one frame, the last frame must carry mask & ~(BTN_SHOOT|BTN_BOMB). 48 decisions x 2 frames = the 96-frame period already frozen in configs/v420/rl-engine-{audit,pilot}.json rollout.shoot_pulse_period; the teacher default of 24 is for 4-frame decisions
must_also: record shoot_pulse_period in the episode identity so a record states which channel produced it
refuse to merge summaries with different shoot_pulse_period values
re-run (never mix) any row that predates the fix if it is to be compared with post-fix rows

minimal_verification.what: the `pulse` mode of .tmp_v420_clearcheck/replay_clear.py is that patch executed outside tools/: same client, same decision_steps, same mask, only the release frame differs

positive_control.already_published: AGENTS.md §8.1: G410-1 teacher 100/100 on S1N; no number is re-read from the confirm-seed artifacts by this task
positive_control.reading: the only difference between the channel that clears 100/100 and the channel that never clears is the SHOOT release, which is this task's finding stated the other way round

cannot_claim: this task did not re-measure any capability number: no policy, no checkpoint, no dev seed was evaluated here
the 0/N counts are unchanged and are still valid negative results for the reason they were reported (the policies die at 733-4,964 frames)
the recorded tape is a teacher recording, not a policy: replaying it through the evaluator channel proves the channel is broken, not that any student could clear
the fix, once applied, would not make any policy clear: it only makes a clear *reportable*

the experiment did not separate a dialogue-gated stall from the end-of-stage wait: it measured that the playfield stops scoring at frame 5,058 on both channels and that only the pulsed channel resumes and clears
no gate, no Wilson interval, no development score, no confirm split (60000-60199) and no corpus seed (1-20) was touched
